title: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent
why_read: A creative game concept that turns the experience of being an LLM subagent into interactive gameplay, interesting from a human-AI interaction design angle.
analysis: This Show HN presents a game where the player role-plays as a subagent receiving instructions from a large language model orchestrator, which is a creative way to explore multi-agent AI workflows experientially. It could offer genuine insight into how agentic AI systems decompose tasks and communicate, framed as entertainment rather than a technical paper. The relatively modest but solid engagement suggests a niche but engaged audience interested in LLM agent architectures.
